reason: A DSH Web interface plugin that lets users select part of a conversation and render it as a shareable PNG with preview, download, and clipboard-copy options.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 中选择对话范围并将其渲染为可预览、下载或复制的 PNG 长图。
summaries.en: Select a range of a DSH Web conversation and render it as a previewable PNG long image for download or clipboard copying.

capabilities: Reads selected conversation content in the web interface
Renders selected content into a PNG image
Downloads the PNG or copies the image to the clipboard
